name: library-desktop
description: E-book library manager built with NestJS, Angular, and Electron

scripts.init-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "angular,nestjs,electron" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:4250 && npm run start:desktop"
